headline: As of 2026-11-09: 75,580,948 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+4.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 75,580,948 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+4.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (11,308,974), Florida (8,340,161), Texas (8,178,699).
